question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
-- Final comprehensive report - show all 236 sellers
WITH base_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_items_sold,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
review_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(orv.review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
packing_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(
            EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP))) / 3600.0
        ) as avg_packing_hours
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
        AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pt.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) as category_sales
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pt.product_category_name_english
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english,
        category_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_sales DESC) as rn
    FROM seller_category_sales
),
top_category AS (
    SELECT seller_id, product_category_name_english as top_category_english
    FROM ranked_categories
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    bm.seller_id,
    bm.total_items_sold,
    ROUND(bm.total_sales, 2) as total_sales,
    ROUND(bm.avg_item_price, 2) as avg_item_price,
    ROUND(COALESCE(rm.avg_review_score, 0), 2) as avg_review_score,
    ROUND(COALESCE(pm.avg_packing_hours, 0), 2) as avg_packing_hours,
    tc.top_category_english
FROM base_metrics bm
LEFT JOIN review_metrics rm ON bm.seller_id = rm.seller_id
LEFT JOIN packing_metrics pm ON bm.seller_id = pm.seller_id
LEFT JOIN top_category tc ON bm.seller_id = tc.seller_id
ORDER BY bm.total_sales DESC

The geolocation table contains geographic coordinates for zip code prefixes. The customers table holds customer identifiers and location data.
